The latest news about our people and community

UCOL nursing ākonga wins national GirlBoss competition

UCOL Whanganui has celebrated a successful cohort from Japan, as part of the collaborative internship programme with National Institute of Technology Tsuruoka College and Whanganui & Partners.

Whanganui artist and lecturer invited to exhibit at prestigious Canada festival

UCOL is thrilled to celebrate Creative Industries Lecturer and award-winning Whanganui textile and fibre artist, Kate Sellar, who has been chosen to exhibit at the World of Threads Festival 2026-27 in Oakville, Canada.

Police and Defence U-Skills students step up for career success

A UCOL programme designed to prepare students for a career in the New Zealand military and aimed at year-12 school pupils is getting good results.
